title: Reel Plan
description: The per-reel axes of a batch, which the edit_decisions spine structurally cannot hold. edit_decisions carries exactly one audio.music object with a single asset_id and exactly one subtitles object, so N reels means N tracks and N subtitle sources. The spine keeps the shared look and one flat cuts[] whose ids are <reel_id>- prefixed; this artifact keeps everything that varies per reel. compose materialises each reel's edit_decisions in memory by filtering the spine on cut_ids and merging one entry from here.

reel_id.description: reel_NN. Minted once at the idea gate; every cut id in cut_ids is prefixed with it.

music_asset_id.description: An asset id, not a path — resolve through asset_manifest.assets[].id.

subtitle_source.description: Asset id of this reel's word-level caption JSON.

audio_offset_seconds.description: In-point into the normalised track, from script.metadata.reels[].window.offset_seconds. Compose muxes the bed from here; without it every reel of a batch cut from one track gets the same opening seconds.

hook.description: The hook card's text. The timing that places it is on the cut list.

cut_ids.description: This reel's cut ids in reel order, which is not necessarily spine order.

corrections.description: Per-reel caption corrections: wrong word (lowercase) -> replacement.

caption_confidence.description: Carried verbatim from script.metadata.reels[].caption_confidence. Compose re-reports these off what it actually burned; a mismatch means a word changed between approval and render.
